title: Affine-coordinate data and the full two-label comparison family
statement: An affine coordinate is a commutative ring A, a scheme X, an isomorphism Spec A ≅ X, a supplied derived equivalence d with a specified localization/pushforward identification hd, and a cochain-complex functor H with its specified tilde/localization identification hH. The K-flat criterion says that tensoring with every acyclic module complex is acyclic. A comparison family assigns, to every commuting coordinate square and two K-flat complexes M,N, a natural isomorphism between extension of scalars followed by H at the target and H at the source followed by derived pullback, on the full induced category of the Boolean labels, including all cross morphisms. These are exactly the three definitions formerly in the parent module; no data or hypothesis is changed. Definitions used: [def-pc-scheme], [def-pc-derived-category], [def-pc-derived-pullback], [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport], [lem-pc-kflat-extension-of-scalars].
